name: What is included in a standard make-ready service?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a standard make-ready service?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard make-ready service generally includes a deep cleaning of all rooms, bathrooms, and kitchens, including appliances. It also covers minor repairs such as fixing leaky faucets, patching small holes in walls, and replacing worn-out light fixtures. Painting of walls and trim is often included, along with ensuring all doors and windows are functioning correctly. We assess each unit individually to provide a scope of work that meets the property's needs and owner expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard make-ready includes deep cleaning, minor repairs, painting, and ensuring basic functionality.
